grounding.states: A 2023 YouGov poll of 1,000 U.S. adults had about 59% liking or loving pineapple on pizza
grounding.from: YouGov poll, March 2023: 22% love, 37% like... By this poll, a majority (about 59%) like or love it.

grounding.states: A 2017 Slice app survey had 54% saying pineapple does not belong on pizza
grounding.from: Slice app survey, 2017: 54% of respondents said pineapple does not belong on pizza.

grounding.states: Americans find anchovies and eggplant more disgusting than pineapple (2019 YouGov)
grounding.from: A 2019 YouGov poll found Americans consider anchovies and eggplant more disgusting than pineapple.

value.answer: Yep, it's ok. It's a taste thing and people are split. A 2023 YouGov poll had about 59% of Americans liking or loving it, but a 2017 Slice survey had 54% saying it doesn't belong. Anchovies and eggplant get more hate than pineapple, so you're in good company either way.
